description: Defines the Transfer class representing an outgoing transfer request, including serialization to/from JSON and list encoding/decoding.

classes.name: Transfer
classes.description: Represents an outgoing transfer request with fields such as id, fromAccountId, toIban, beneficiaryName, amount, currency, createdAt, and note. Includes methods for JSON serialization/deserialization and list encoding/decoding.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the Transfer object into a JSON-compatible Map.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a Transfer instance from a JSON Map.

methods.name: encodeList
methods.description: Encodes a list of Transfer objects into a JSON string.

methods.name: decodeList
methods.description: Decodes a JSON string into a list of Transfer objects.
